Q: Excel Sumifs - multiple column criteria A:

With the usage of the BYROW function the below formula creates all possible variations of the 3 criteria

=LET(result,DROP(GROUPBY(IF(--LEFT(D2:D17,SEARCH("-",D2:D17)-1)>=70000,CHOOSECOLS(A2:G17,2,3),""),CHOOSECOLS(A2:G17,5,6,7),SUM,0,0),1),
VSTACK({"Location","Type",2021,2022,2023,"Total Years"},HSTACK(result,BYROW(CHOOSECOLS(result,3,4,5),LAMBDA(x,SUM(x))))))

The formula first generates the from values of the Price range, and returns only the rows that greater than 70000.
This is the base of the GROUPBY function, which returns the SUM of the different criteria.
At the end makes the header row and SUM the calculated values for all years columns.

The formula is in cell A20 and spill the table.

Q: Match case statement with multiple 'or' conditions in each case A:

cases accept a "guard" clause, which you can use for this purpose:

match x:
  case w if w in a:
    # this was the "case in a" in the question
  case w if w in b:
    # this was the "case in b" in the question
  ...

the w here actually captures the value of x, part of the syntax here too, but it's more useful in some other fancy cases listed on the linked whatsnew page.

Q: Rotate bottle image in HTML A:

Two options :

First is to get this gif (if you already have gif or png sequence) make sequence of animation (If you have 3d project you can also generate images from 3d software). Then use some canvas2d framework and preview this sequence .

  • You can do it also with classic html tags and timers .

Secund is use three.js or similar webgl engines to render this obj. Than it is a simple rotation in 3d space . Blender is freeware use it. Import object (obj) intro blender . Goto edit mode and select faces for botle textures - press space type "unwrap" , insert you image . Export from blender to obj . See how to load obj with three.js with textures .

Both projects are simple and they can works on all devices (desktops/mobiles device).
